Image 1 is the sole source of product truth, an EXISTING photographed coin/bar. Image 2 is the exact approved background; copy it unchanged at its native 1254-square scale. Image 3 is the owner-approved COMPOSITION reference only, not a source of product details, sharpness, blur, material or artwork.
Faithfully extract/reposition the existing photographed face(s). Keep the exact silhouette, proportions, viewing angle, rim, relief, portrait/deity identity, symbols, lettering, numerals, wear, metal finish and any genuine gold-tone areas. Put the unchanged product on the exact background in Image 2: faint original central watermark, copper lower-right monogram and exact black "DDA Silver" must stay at their original scale/positions. Do not enlarge/reposition the watermark to expose it; it may be hidden by the product. No additional text, logos, weights, borders, props or mirror reflections. Full product perimeter visible; branding unobstructed.

Exclude the other face deliberately; it stays available in the existing product gallery. Make this one existing face prominent, optically centered at x627,y565, longest dimension about 850–900px. Preserve actual shape/aspect ratio and source perspective. Do not make ovals circular. Match Image 3's single-face framing with complete rim visible and room above the bottom-right lockup.
